title: Count Islands
statement: You are given a 2D grid of 0s and 1s representing land (1) and water (0). An island is a group of 1s connected horizontally or vertically (not diagonally). The grid is given as a list of lists of integers, grid[row][col]. Return the number of distinct islands in the grid.
hints: This is a connected-components problem on a grid; each cell is a node connected to its up/down/left/right neighbors.
Use a visited set/array so each land cell is only counted once, and flood-fill outward from every unvisited land cell you find.
Iterate every cell; when you find an unvisited 1, increment your island count and run BFS/DFS marking all reachable 1s as visited before continuing the scan.
